initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 24/60 − 27/90 = 0.1. R214-1 supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect. The observed distribution therefore does not uniquely determine the requested average causal risk difference; passing arithmetic checks does not resolve identification.
